items.source: This is particularly useful for delegating to existing data access code that expects a CqlSession to work on and throws DriverException. For newly written code, it is strongly recommended to use AsyncCqlTemplate's more specific operations, for example a query or update variant.
items.translation: 这对于委托给现有的数据访问代码非常有用，这些代码期望使用 `CqlSession` 进行操作并抛出 `DriverException`。对于新编写的代码，强烈建议使用AsyncCqlTemplate中更具体的操作，例如 `query` 或 `update` 的变体。

items.source: Allows for returning a result object created within the callback, i.e. a domain object or a collection of domain objects. Note that there's special support for single step actions: see AsyncCqlTemplate.queryForObject(String, Class) etc. A thrown RuntimeException is treated as application exception: it gets propagated to the caller of the template.
items.translation: 支持返回在回调中创建的结果对象，即领域对象或领域对象的集合。请注意，单步操作具有特殊支持：请参阅 AsyncCqlTemplate.queryForObject(String, Class) 等方法。抛出的 RuntimeException 被视为应用程序异常：它会被传播到模板的调用者。
